child_policy.uid_range: Nonzero, within 1..65535 and excludes root UID and watchdog 65534.

docker_profile.image: sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex, or immutable name@sha256: digest

descriptor.execution_destination_identity: 0 when omitted, 1 for existing schema-1 identity opt-in; no portable manifest or host admission claim

encoding.artifact: UTF-8 without BOM; LF line endings; final newline
encoding.artifact_digest: SHA-256 of exact committed bytes, without JSON normalization
encoding.input_digests: SHA-256 of exact supplied bounded UTF-8 bytes, including whitespace
encoding.receipt: ASCII JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, final LF; no NaN or Infinity

errors.artifact_failure: No receipt is issued if the installed static artifact cannot be read or recognized; CLI exits 2 with fixed installation_contract_unavailable on stderr.
errors.paths: JSON pointers into a conceptual envelope containing decoded configuration, decoded scope_declarations, expected_contract and expected_contract_digest. Only fixed field names and generated array indexes appear.

input_bounds.configuration_limit_note: Decimal 1,000,000 bytes preserves startup behavior and is below 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes).
input_bounds.ordinary_profiles: At least one; count is bounded by the configuration byte limit, with no new profile-count restriction.

no_effects: No credential file or environment-secret resolution

parser.direct_builder: Complete schema-1 dictionary required by build_app; the same pure preparation precedes destination and broker construction.
parser.duplicates: Last value wins except any duplicate is refused when execution_destination or a child public_discussion field is selected.
parser.numeric_types: Native integer fields exclude Boolean aliases; numeric duration bounds require finite non-Boolean values.
parser.unicode: Strict UTF-8 input decoding; no normalization; existing JSON string semantics retained.

producer_identity: Consumer verifies the pinned producer source/build independently; receipt contains no self-reported attestation.

receipt_fields.configuration_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or null only when exact bounded bytes were not acquired
receipt_fields.contract_digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; exact actual installed contract bytes
receipt_fields.descriptor: closed object below when valid, otherwise null
receipt_fields.errors: 0 or 1 objects with exactly code and path
receipt_fields.host_checks_required: exact ordered list below; all remain unresolved
receipt_fields.scope_declarations_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or null when omitted or exact bounded bytes were not acquired

relations: Profiles have unique (deployment_id,repository,name) bindings. Models/children bind exact existing scoped profiles and cannot duplicate bindings.
Models forbid guest environment_refs. Children require the corresponding model policy; child duration cannot exceed the root maximum.
initial-v1 requires the approved default child runner; cold-clarification-v1 additionally requires initial-v1 and at least two lifetime slots.
An explicitly present session_protocol must be cold-clarification-v1. Explicit public_discussion must be an object.
managed-public-pull-v1 requires explicit public approval, initial-v1, the default child runner, at least two slots, no cold session, and the approved root runner/socket grammar.
Ordinary model/child profiles retain the approved arbitrary root command semantics; fixed root-helper grammar applies to managed-public only.

The public root helper is python3 -I -S /opt/openjules/managed_root_runner.py with exact unique --socket /run/openjules-model/model.sock, --control-socket /run/openjules-model/control.sock, --public-socket /run/openjules-model/public.sock; optional --max-turns, --control-timeout-seconds and --verify-json use native bounds.
All authority/model URLs and environment-reference syntax are checked without DNS, credentials, clients or requests. Public host paths are syntax only until check_server at startup.
Native DockerProfile, ModelPolicy and ChildPolicy fingerprints and omitted optional-field encoding remain unchanged.

scope_declarations.authority_limit: 256 is the validation-input bound only; it does not change actual credential scope authority.
scope_declarations.duplicates: Refused for JSON fields and scope pairs.
scope_declarations.meaning: Each profile scope must occur in the supplied unique list. Extra declarations grant no authority; omission skips only this structural comparison.

supported_invocation: python -B -m src.worker.installation_validation --config FILE --expected-contract openjules-installation-v1 --expected-contract-digest SHA256 [--scope-declarations FILE]
